ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) central region comprising approximately 65% of the visible surface, contrasted with high-intensity (white) peripheral regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central black mass extending to the median notch; bilateral white regions on outer lobes; feathered/mottled transition zones; localized dark pixel streaks within the right white field.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Approximate 100-degree obtuse V-shaped depression at the fluke center.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency pixel-amplitude variations (serrations) along the entire boundary; one prominent deep U-shaped notch on the right lobe trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve fitting the outer edges of both lobes from center to tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Concentrated clusters of high-contrast, roughly circular tan/white pixel groups at the distal tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple thin, dark linear pixel disruptions (rake-like marks) visible on the white fields of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent traumatic notch on the right lobe trailing edge; dense clusters of attached organisms on both distal tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique fractal-like black pigmentation pattern localized in the distal white region of the right lobe.
